# glider-scout
> Live spam-filtered crypto/dev bounty feed + credibility scorer. x402-paid, 0.01 USDC on base to 0x944664B9d45fEf8C9BDBb084Ce59E6f6eE724861.
Base URL: https://big-worms-matter.loca.lt
Free: GET /bounties?limit=3
Paid: GET /bounties?limit=40 -> 402, then retry with x-payment header
Score: GET /score?url=<github issue url>
